svg.aria-label: One firmware image in a programmer on a bench. On the left it goes into the car's real boards: three MainLite modules on their backplanes, wired to the car's harness. On the right the same image goes into their emulated twins, inside an open container: the same three boards on a virtual CAN bus bar, with device models (an LTC6811 chain and a BMI088) beside them.
